purpose: Discreet status-only contract for Money Hub. No balances or financial amounts leave Life Hub.
rules: This is a contract, not an active Notion connection or runtime privacy filter.
Life Hub is the source of truth for financial detail. Notion holds actions and discreet review statuses only.
Export only allowlisted fields. Use user-approved neutral display names and enum statuses; never interpolate private values into text.
sourceUpdatedAt must represent a genuine source-account refresh, never a page edit or export time. Missing timestamps mean unknown.
lastSuccessfulSyncAt is set only after delivery to Notion is verified. A failed delivery must not mark data current.
Derive stale status from sourceUpdatedAt using a user-configured review interval; do not invent a freshness threshold.
Never store export payloads, credentials or private data in this public repository or browser JavaScript.
Do not create duplicate Money Hub pages or finance databases.
